tokens.name: kagit
tokens.usage: Paper: the scaffold background behind every screen, and the inset ground of picture descriptions inside a card. Also the text colour on filled yazi (selected language key, answered strip box).

tokens.name: sayfa
tokens.usage: Sheet: Kart, Acilir and option surfaces, dialogs and canvas. Also onError.

tokens.name: yazi
tokens.usage: Ink: all primary text on kagit, sayfa, dogruZemin and yanlisZemin (14.5:1 light, 15.4:1 dark on kagit). Also the fill of a selected language key and an answered strip box.

tokens.name: soluk
tokens.usage: Muted text (SolukMetin): translations under the German line, hints, dates, footer, unanswered strip numbers. Reads 5.5:1 on kagit and 5.1:1 on yanlisZemin in light; 7.2:1 on sayfa in dark.

tokens.name: cizgi
tokens.usage: Hairline: Kart border (1px), tab-bar baseline (2px), unanswered strip box, progress track. Decorative only (1.4:1 on sayfa): never a control boundary, use secenekKenar there.

tokens.name: secenekKenar
tokens.usage: Control boundary at rest (1.5px): answer options and the Acilir dropdown. 4.1:1 on sayfa light, 4.8:1 dark: clears 3:1.

tokens.name: vurgu
tokens.usage: Accent (ColorScheme.primary): FilledButton fill, OutlinedButton and TextButton text and 1.5px border, selected option border (2.5px), active tab underline (3px), current strip box ring, progress fill, links, focus. As text, 8.4:1 on sayfa light, 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: vurguUstu
tokens.usage: Text and icons on vurgu fills (onPrimary). White in light; deep navy in dark, because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: isaret
tokens.usage: Marker yellow (secondary): Etiket chips, the 'Koçu' label in the wordmark, the 4px start rule beside an explanation. Same value in both themes. Never text on a light ground (1.4:1 on kagit).

tokens.name: isaretUstu
tokens.usage: Text on isaret (10.3:1).

tokens.name: dogru
tokens.usage: Correct: right-answer border and check_circle icon, 'Doğru.' feedback text, verified icons, correct strip boxes. 4.7:1 on dogruZemin light. dogru and yanlis differ by hue only (1.2:1), so pair them with an icon, a word, or a lightness difference (the result strip fills wrong boxes solid yanlis against light dogruZemin).

tokens.name: dogruZemin
tokens.usage: Tint behind a correct option or correct strip box.

tokens.name: yanlis
tokens.usage: Wrong (ColorScheme.error): wrong-answer border and cancel icon, 'Yanlış.' feedback text, failed-result card border, and the solid fill of a wrong or blank box in the result strip (number in sayfa, 6.5:1 light, 8.0:1 dark). 5.5:1 on yanlisZemin light, 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: yanlisZemin
tokens.usage: Tint behind a wrong option, wrong strip box, or the result card after a failed mock test.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Result score in the mock-test result card ('17 / 33'). Tabular figures.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Home hero headline, once per screen.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The 'LiD Koçu' wordmark in the app bar only.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Premium sheet headline; onboarding step 2 title (line height 1.25 there).

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Onboarding step 1 title; language names in the language picker.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Exam countdown, always LTR, tabular figures.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: The German question line (Almanca). Always LTR.
styles.sample: Wie viele Bundesländer hat die Bundesrepublik Deutschland?

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Baslik: the title inside a Kart; marked as a semantic header.

styles.name: option
styles.usage: German text of an answer option; state names in the onboarding list.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Filled, outlined and text buttons; tab labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Plain Text with no style (Material bodyMedium, raised from 14/20 to 16/24 in tema.dart). Explanations, the hero subline, result lines.
styles.sample: Sorular Almanca sorulur. Burada Almancasını görür, kendi dilinde anlarsın.

styles.name: muted
styles.usage: SolukMetin default, in soluk: translations under options, hints, dates.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Footer notes and links (links in vurgu, underlined).

styles.name: lang-key
styles.usage: Two-letter language keys (TR · EN · DE · AR).

styles.name: chip
styles.sample: Güncel bilgi: sınavdan önce kontrol et

styles.name: chip-sm
styles.usage: Small Etiket ('Ücretsiz örnek açıklama'); numbers in the answer strip.

spacing.note: The Bosluk scale in tema.dart (Bosluk.b2 … Bosluk.b40): the only paddings and gaps the widgets use.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between the lines inside an answer option; Etiket vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inset of a language key inside its 48×48 hit area.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Answer-strip gap; between language keys; Sekmeler horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Explanation inner gap; picture-description inner gap; gap between 'LiD' and the Koçu label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between answer options; Etiket horizontal padding; inside the question header.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Explanation start padding after the 4px rule; result-offer card gap; picture-description vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of an answer option.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap inside a Kart; button vertical padding; option and Acilir horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on the exam, result and onboarding screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Kart padding; button horizontal padding; page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between sections (cards) on a screen.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page top padding on the first screen; reserved space above the banner ad.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the Premium sheet.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Etiket, the Koçu label, answer-strip boxes.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Progress bar (half its 10px height).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, answer options, Acilir, language keys, picture-description inset.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Kart, result-offer card, onboarding language list.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Kart border, strip box at rest, language key.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Option at rest and correct/wrong, OutlinedButton, Acilir, failed-result card.

tokens.name: border-tabline
tokens.usage: Tab-bar baseline in cizgi.

tokens.name: border-selected
tokens.usage: Selected option and current strip box, in vurgu.

tokens.name: border-tab-active
tokens.usage: Active tab underline in vurgu.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Start-side rule in isaret beside an explanation.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, option, tab, Acilir and language key (48×48).

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Progress bar height.

tokens.name: strip-columns
tokens.usage: Answer strip: 33 boxes in 11 columns.
